theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtfrbv_face_neighbourhoods
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ), (∀ p q : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ), StrictMono p.1 → StrictMono q.1 → p ≠ q → ∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → 1 ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∨ ∃ j, min (y j) (1 - y j) ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → ∃ N : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → Set (Euclid P), ∀ p : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ), StrictMono p.1 → IsOpen (N p) ∧ (∀ y : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) → (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ N p) ∧ ∀ q : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ), StrictMono q.1 → q ≠ p → (∀ y : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∉ N p) ∧ Disjoint (N p) (N q)
